title: CE60043: Advanced Structural Analysis
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction, variational principles; Finite element techniques - element
properties; Application to plane stress, plane strain, axi-symmetric, plate
bending analysis. Application to 3-D analysis; Non linear material and
geometric problems; Finite difference and finite strip techniques; Boundary
element method applicable to stress analysis; Special topics.
